description_en: Queries the top user agents for a website
name: DescribeDomainTopUserAgent

parameters.help_en:
The service region. Valid values:
cn: the Chinese mainland.
cn-hongkong: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
服务地域。取值：
cn：中国内地。
cn-hongkong：非中国内地
parameters.name: region

parameters.help_en:
The domain name of the website.
A traffic forwarding rule for website services must be configured for the domain name. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html to query all domain names
parameters.help_zh:
网站业务的域名。
域名必须已配置网站业务转发规则。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91724.html查询所有域名
parameters.name: domain

parameters.help_en:
The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The time must be exact to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询开始时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: seconds.
The time must be exact to the minute
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间。时间戳格式，单位：秒。
必须为整点分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en:
The source of the queried data. Valid values:
block: statistics on blocked access sources
visit: statistics on normal access sources
parameters.help_zh:
查询数据的来源。取值：
block：表示被拦截的访问来源统计。
visit：表示正常访问来源统计
parameters.name: query_type

Domain.description_en: The domain name of the website

UserAgent.description_en: The Base64-encoded value of the User-Agent

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. This is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot and locate issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的 ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
